entries.24a2db9d95169c7b: Affluent individuals and corporations seeking investment real estate
entries.25d7dfa5bd8398da: A reportable segment in which consolidated subsidiary Morizō Co.,Ltd. undertakes the design and construction of custom-built homes for customers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,377 million. It builds mid-to-high-end custom-built homes using domestically produced fine timber “Kiso hinoki”, mainly in the Kanto-Koshinetsu area.
entries.3df0b4e15996c74a: “Good homes that first-time buyers working diligently in regional cities or suburbs of the Tokyo metropolitan area can afford without strain.” Built-for-sale homes are planned and developed mainly in regional core cities and suburbs of the Tokyo metropolitan area.
entries.4fa780d277cf87c8: A company engaged in real estate sales, such as ready-built houses and investment condominiums, and in construction contracting for custom-built houses using domestic hinoki cypress.
entries.6466db2045f12636: A business that plans, develops and supplies, by whole building, the investment condominium “Lesco” series, the investment wooden apartment “Aterēze” series and simple lodging facilities (minpaku buildings), and a business that buys and sells used real estate such as tenant buildings. Revenue for each category alone is not disclosed.
entries.8d4fa96542bac847: A reportable segment in which consolidated subsidiary Morizō Co.,Ltd. undertakes the design and construction of custom-built homes for customers.
entries.a97ac9f5fb290ebc: A reportable segment that sells built-for-sale homes and investment real estate. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥2,038 million. Built-for-sale homes are planned and developed mainly in regional core cities and suburbs of the Tokyo metropolitan area. For investment real estate, the company sells investment condominiums, investment wooden apartment buildings and simple lodging facilities by whole building, and also buys and sells used real estate. Sanai Home Co.,Ltd., which became a subsidiary on January 6, 2025, also conducts business in this segment.

entries.eb7f30827a2ae7a9: “Good homes that first-time buyers working diligently in regional cities or suburbs of the Tokyo metropolitan area can afford without strain.” Built-for-sale homes are planned and developed mainly in regional core cities and suburbs of the Tokyo metropolitan area.
